Freelance Game Tester (PS5) | Remote | 3-Day Project 
 We are hiring PS5 owners for a short-term game testing project with Side Inc.
 Project Details

• Dates: 3rd to 5th December 2026 (3 days)

• Timings: 4:30 PM - 7:30 PM IST

• Location: Remote

• Openings: 55+ Freelancers

 Key Responsibilities

• Play the assigned game on a PS5 console for approximately 3 hours per day.

• Participate throughout the project duration of 3 consecutive days.

• Complete surveys/questionnaires provided by the client.

• Provide detailed gameplay feedback and observations.

• Follow project instructions and timelines accurately.

 Requirements
 Mandatory Eligibility Criteria
 Applicants must meet ALL of the following requirements:

• Own a PlayStation 5 (PS5) console

• Have an active PlayStation Network (PSN) account

• Have a stable and reliable internet connection

• Be available for all project sessions during the scheduled timings

• Be comfortable completing feedback forms and surveys in English

• PS5 ownership and PSN account ownership will be verified by the client

 Interested candidates who meet all the above requirements are encouraged to apply. 🎮
